hints.content:
The point $(5,2)$ lies in the shaded area of both of the inequalities.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a graphed system of inequalities. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. There is a solid line representing an inequality that goes through the points zero, three and three, negative one. The shaded region for the inequality is above the line. There is another solid line representing the second inequality that goes through the points zero, zero and three, two. The shaded region for this inequality is below the line. The point five, two is plotted in the shaded region of both inequalities.

hints.content: Yes, $(5,2)$ is a solution of the system of inequalities.
